messages.subject: Project Falcon - response mark-up (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Our response attached. We've met you in the middle: availability at 97.75%, liability cap at 135% of trailing 12-month Charges with a £17.5m supply super-cap. We've held 30-day payment but, as a trade, reduced the signature advance from 15% to 10%. I think that clears the open points. If you're content we can move to an execution version in the new year.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
